chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musanna al-Hannat, from Is'haq ibn Yazeed, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, from the rights of the Muslim upon the Muslim is that he answers him when he invites him.
ai.seo_question: What is the right of a Muslim upon another Muslim regarding invitations?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the communal obligation of responding to invitations, reinforcing social bonds and mutual care within the Ummah. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on adab (etiquette) and the rights of neighbors and kin, serving as a practical mechanism for maintaining unity and preventing estrangement among believers.
